metadata.description: Agent skills for electronics — design, simulate, source parts, and drive lab instruments.

plugins.name: micro-cap
plugins.description: Run Micro-Cap 12 circuit simulations headlessly (batch mode): write SPICE netlists, run AC/transient/DC/distortion analyses and digital/mixed-signal logic (gates, flip-flops, 74xx families, power-up sequencing), and parse the numeric output files.

plugins.name: 3dpart-as-code
plugins.description: Build 3D-printable parts design-as-code: every dimension, fit, body and check in a C# part.cs single source of truth, geometry in build123d scripts that hold no numbers, STL (print-oriented) and STEP regenerated as build outputs and gated — dimensions probed off the solid, watertight single-shell meshes inside the printer envelope, clearance and insertion-sweep fits against mating parts (pcb-as-code boards included) — with project tooling in C# .NET 10 file-based apps (dotnet run tool.cs). Design mode invents a part; reproduce mode copies an existing one from a caliper measurement sheet with numbered callout renders. Ships tested C# templates (part model, STL mesh checks, a dependency-free PNG renderer, the gates, the venv runner) and a build123d helper with an xUnit suite that runs a worked example end to end, plus a 3dpart-review skill: multi-wave sweeps of cheap read-only reviewer agents over the docs, part.cs, scripts and renders, triaged by the session, with fixes applied in the source and the parts rebuilt.

plugins.name: parts-search
plugins.description: Search electronic parts across DigiKey, Mouser, and Newark (element14) by MPN, distributor part code, or keyword — normalized stock, unit price at quantity, price breaks, lifecycle status, and product URLs where the vendor provides them, with an as-of timestamp; find variants and substitute candidates with explainable reasons; pull one part's full parameter table and datasheets; re-validate a shortlist of MPNs in one batch check; and set up, list, test, or clear vendor API keys in the Windows Credential Manager.

plugins.name: pcb-as-code
plugins.description: Build hardware projects design-as-code: KiCad 10+ schematics and PCBs generated from a C# single source of truth, verified pin-by-pin against it, autorouted headlessly with FreeRouting, gated by ERC/DRC, and exported to fab gerbers/BOM/renders. Ships tested C# templates with an xUnit suite, plus an hw-review skill: multi-wave read-only reviewer sweeps over changed docs, design source, schematics and boards, triaged by the session, with fixes applied in the source and boards regenerated — never hand-edited.

plugins.name: visa
plugins.description: Control VISA-addressable lab instruments (DMMs, scopes, power supplies, signal generators) over GPIB, USB-TMC, Serial/ASRL, or TCPIP/LXI — send SCPI commands, read measurements, control the bus, read/write VISA attributes, do USB-TMC control transfers, and move binary block payloads to/from files.
